title: loopback left open (rabbitmq) — review required
description: loopback runs with an open setting: loopback_users.guest = false. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply loopback-only guest plus users and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
